parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Lovell et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘partially compensatory’ strategy in consumer decision-making.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the procedure of the study by Knutson et al. (2007) on pre-cognitive decisions in
consumer decision-making.

parts.label: (c)
